output.patientMessage: You can manage this at home for now with over-the-counter itch relief; a pharmacist can advise on options. A poison ivy rash often seems to spread for a few days in areas exposed to the plant, which fits what you describe. If the rash spreads well beyond your forearms, involves your face or genitals, or you get pus, increasing redness/pain, or fever, arrange a clinician visit that day — urgent care if a message can't be answered. If you develop trouble breathing or facial swelling, call 911.
